run_get_embeddings: run get_embeddings to compute and store normalized embeddings from a pretrained model onto numpy memmap arrays
create_get_embeddings: create a get_embeddings call that processes a dataloader batch and writes normalized encodings to memmap storage
test_get_embeddings: test get_embeddings with a pretrained model, dataloader returning data batches, paths, and batch indices
refactor_get_embeddings: refactor get_embeddings to support multi-GPU parallelization across multiple devices
